name: PAPER ANGEL
source:
You have become conscious and find yourself taking care of “Spinwhim”. Why? Who know! It is just great that you are here :-)! 

[From [url=https://slitherbop.itch.io/paper-angel]Itch.io[/url]]

Made for Winter Visual Novel Jam 2022.
translation:
你恢復了意識，發現自己正在照顧「Spinwhim」。為什麼？誰知道呢！總之你能來真是太好了:-)！

[引自[url=https://slitherbop.itch.io/paper-angel]Itch.io[/url]]

為2022年冬季視覺小說創作賽製作。
